contracts: (The selector has nonzero discovery and proves post-cancel secret unavailability; missing prerequisites are blocked.) AND (The selector has nonzero discovery on Windows and proves denied foreign write plus unchanged target; unavailable prerequisites are blocked.) AND (The selector verifies authorized access and unauthorized-secret absence with nonzero discovery; harness gaps are blocked.) AND (The selector verifies platform-secret non-observability with nonzero discovery; unsupported environment is blocked.) AND (三类创建后权限漂移均在修复前阻止 Runner，且仅审计修复成功后解除。) AND (测试发现并执行唯一 OS 边界 selector，确认系统拒绝且兄弟 Project 内容和元数据哈希不变。) AND (测试发现并执行唯一 secrets OS 边界 selector，确认系统拒绝且资源未变化。) AND (测试发现并执行唯一平台数据库 OS 边界 selector，确认系统拒绝且 fixture 未变化。) AND (测试发现并执行唯一跨 Account OS 边界 selector，确认系统拒绝且目标资源未变化。) AND (目标测试被发现并执行，确认 timeout path 真实运行、操作终止、子进程不再存活并记录 timeout outcome。) AND (目标测试被发现并执行，验证每种漂移在修复前拒绝发布、修复后重新评估并产生审计关联。) AND (目标测试被发现并执行，验证每种漂移在修复前拒绝启动、修复后重新评估并产生审计关联。) AND (精确 Runner 测试被发现并执行；漂移时启动拒绝、修复前重试拒绝、修复后允许且审计存在。)
selector_intents: Cancel the real Runner and probe its former context and secret store; fail when the fixture secret remains readable or cleanup does not complete.
Inspect the dispatched workload environment and accessible secret store; fail when any non-authorized fixture is readable or authorized material escapes Run scope.
Inspect the real Runner environment and accessible execution context; fail when the platform fixture secret is present or readable.
Launch the production Runner and attempt a harmless write to a different Account Workspace; fail when the OS permits the write or target content changes.
PhaseB.Repair.RunnerBoundaryTests 中 Workspace 移动后 ACL/继承/所有者漂移 Runner 启动阻止测试，断言启动拒绝及修复前持续拒绝。
PhaseB.Repair.RunnerBoundaryTests 中平台升级后 ACL/继承/所有者漂移 Runner 启动阻止测试，断言启动拒绝及修复前持续拒绝。
PhaseB.Repair.RunnerBoundaryTests.AclDrift_BlocksLaunchAndPublication_Creation 应断言创建后漂移阻止 Runner 启动直至审计修复；修复前启动成功则失败。
Run the exact Runner secret-injection selector; fail if undiscovered, unbuildable, fixtures are unavailable, or the real Runner context is not launched.
Run the exact Windows restricted-process foreign-Workspace selector; fail if undiscovered, unbuildable, missing required OS privileges or fixtures, or unable to observe a real permission result.
Run the exact cancellation-cleanup selector; fail if the real Runner cannot be cancelled, the fixture is missing, or post-cancel probing is unavailable.
Run the exact platform-to-Runner isolation selector; fail if the real Runner cannot launch or the platform fixture cannot be established and probed.
